column1: Nueva Vizcaya Climate + Dengue (Monthly) — LSTM-ready workbook
- Climate: NASA POWER Point Monthly CSV (2015-01 to 2025-12) for 16.49N, 121.17E
- Train/Test split: TRAIN = 2015-01 to 2022-12; TEST = 2023-01 to 2025-12.
* Lagged features: LAG_1 to LAG_12 for climate variables and dengue cases.
- Scaling: Min-Max scaling computed ONLY from TRAIN rows (prevents data leakage).
Sheets you will use for LSTM:
- Win12_ClimCases_Scaled: 12-month window features (scaled) + target dengue cases.
- Win12_Clim_Scaled: same but climate-only (no dengue lags).
Tip: If you want a plug-and-play dataset with no formulas, use the *_Values sheets.
For LSTM input (already windowed): Win12_ClimCases_Scaled_Values or Win12_Clim_Scaled_Values.
